options.en: We usually have lunch at one.
We have usually lunch at one.
We usually has lunch at one.
Usually we having lunch at one.

why.en: Usually goes before the main verb, and with we the verb is have: we usually have.
why.uz: Usually asosiy feʼldan oldin keladi; we bilan feʼl have shaklida boʻladi: we usually have.
why.ru: Usually ставится перед основным глаголом; с we глагол имеет форму have: we usually have.

stem.en: I ___ late for school. I always come on time.

why.en: Never goes after the verb be: I am never late. It is already negative, so no not or don't.
why.uz: Never be feʼlidan keyin keladi: I am never late. Uning oʻzi inkor maʼnosida, shuning uchun not yoki don't kerak emas.
why.ru: Never ставится после глагола be: I am never late. Оно уже отрицательное, поэтому not или don't не нужны.
